subject: MAP milestones and closing timeline — pricing tie to ramp / renewal uplift
messages:
From: Elon Chen <elon.chen@vectrix.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Eval plan + MAP for Q3 POC

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency and the cost estimates for our conversational assistant POC. We want to move fast but need a clear mutual action plan so we can align internal stakeholders (infra, security, procurement).

High-level asks:
- 8 week eval window starting May 3rd (dedicated capacity trial)
- Ramp targets: 50k tokens/day by week 4, 250k tokens/day by week 8
- Preferred pricing: tiered commit with a 6-month renewal cap on uplift (we're sensitive to post-trial price surprises)
- Security checklist: SOC2 evidence and data retention controls (we'll send the questionnaire)

Can you draft a MAP we can review? Also please call out what minimum commit would unlock the pricing we need (and any one-time credits for the eval).

Best,
Elon
Head of Product, Vectrix

Attachment: none

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval plan + MAP for Q3 POC

Elon — thanks, confident we can support the timeline. I attached a first-pass MAP (Vectrix_MAP_Draft_v1.pdf) that maps milestones, owners, acceptance criteria, and conditional pricing tied to commits. Summary highlights:

- Week 0 (kickoff): access, baseline perf tests, SOC2 checklist entry (owner: Vectrix)
- Week 2: integration milestone (validate end-to-end latencies < 250ms p95) — unlocks 10% eval credit
- Week 4: ramp to 50k tokens/day — unlocks pilot rate (per-token price A) if commitment to 3-month reserved capacity is signed
- Week 8 (eval close): 250k tokens/day target — converts to tiered commit pricing; we propose a staged-commit approach to cap uplift on renewal (details below)

Commercial proposal (high level):
- Pilot pricing: $0.0008 / token for eval period (applied as credit)
- Staged commit path: 3mo reserved at 250k/day equivalent -> mid-term renewal cap of +15% YoY unless conversion to annual reserved capacity (in which case cap is +8%)
- One-time onboarding credit: $15k if contract executed before May 20th

I copied Ben to help with the exact pricing sheet and Neha in finance for any uplift/cap exceptions. Next steps: can you confirm internal approvers and whether procurement needs a contract milestone (PO or similar) before the kickoff?

Thanks,
Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@vectrix.ai>

Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 10:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Eval plan + MAP for Q3 POC

Hi Jasmine — appreciate the clear MAP. A couple of asks from procurement/finance before we move to sign:

1) Can you soften the staged-commit renewal cap? +15% feels punitive for us unless we meet clear quality metrics post-pilot. Would you accept a +10% cap tied to model-quality SLA (token accuracy on our eval set)?
2) For the 3-month reserved commitment to unlock pilot rate — would Redwood accept a ramped commit (start 1.0x equivalent month 1, 2.0x month 2) rather than flat 250k/day immediately?

Also, SOC2 evidence: we will send the standard questionnaire by EOD.

If acceptable, we'll prepare a PO for the onboarding credit and proposed staged commit.

Priya
Program Manager, Vectrix

Cc: Elon Chen <elon.chen@vectrix.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@vectrix.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:32:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Eval plan + MAP for Q3 POC — procurement asks (pricing/uplift)

Ben / Neha — looping you in. Vectrix is asking to: (1) cap renewal uplift at +10% tied to QA metrics, and (2) accept a ramped commit instead of immediate flat 250k/day.

My read: both requests are reasonable commercial concessions if we can structure the MAP with clear acceptance gates and a quality SLA. Proposed internal adjustments (please advise):
- Offer: renewal uplift cap = +10% if model-quality (F1 on their eval set) >= baseline at 30 days after go-live; otherwise fallback to +15%
- Commit: allow ramped commit over first 2 months (1.0x -> 2.0x), but require minimum annualized revenue floor if they convert to annual within 60 days of eval close
- Keep onboarding credit $15k conditional on PO/DocuSign within 10 business days of proposal

Ben — can you populate the attached pricing sheet with exact numbers and mark items that require leadership sign-off? Neha — need guidance on the annualized floor language and whether we can accept the metric-linked uplift cap.

Thanks,
Jasmine

Subject: Re: Fwd: Eval plan + MAP for Q3 POC — procurement asks (pricing/uplift)

Team — I updated pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx with concrete numbers and built two commercial paths:

Option A (Preferred) — Staged commit -> Annual conversion
- Eval period pricing credit (applied retroactively): $0.0008 / token
- Staged commitment: Month1 = 100k/day equiv (0.4x), Month2 = 200k/day equiv (0.8x), Month3 = 250k/day (1.0x)
- Annual conversion incentive: additional 5% discount and renewal uplift cap = +8%

Option B — Ramped pilot then quarterly reserved
- If Vectrix needs a softer ramp, accept the +10% uplift cap tied to their QA metric but require a minimum annual revenue floor of $120k if they do not convert to annual within 60 days post-eval

I believe Option B addresses their procurement ask while preserving downside protection for Redwood. Marking Option B as leadership-approval required for the uplift cap provision.

Neha — can you confirm whether the $120k floor is acceptable and whether the QA metric language is implementable from an accounting/renewal perspective? If so, I'll push Option B to the docu-sign flow and include the PO instructions.

Ben
Director, Commercials — Redwood Inference
